top_signals.title: David Byrne Explains How Forgotten Ideas Come Back to Life
top_signals.summary: History is littered with ideas that have been tossed aside, only for them to gain relevance at some later date. Think of Moby-Dick: forgotten in Melville’s time, but now regarded as the great American novel. Or the work of economist Hyman Minsky, which became influential a decade after his death, when the 2008 financial crisis made “the Minsky Moment”a mainstream term. These are just a couple of the things we talk about with the legendary musician David Byrne on today’s podcast. Byrne’s new book
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
